content: विवर्ण {%a.%} .²1 Colourless, pale, wan, pallid; नरेन्द्रमार्गाट्ट इव प्रपेदे विवर्णभावं स स भूमिपालः <ls>R. 6. 67</ls>. .²2 Discoloured, deprived of water (as a gem.); विवर्णमणीकृतम् (कनकवलयम्) <ls>Ś. 3. 12</ls>. .²3 Low, vile. .²4 Ignorant, stupid, unlettered. .²5 Bad-coloured; <ls>Mb. 12. 36. 38</ls>. .{@-र्णः@} An outcast, a man belonging to low caste.
